description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Hon. Provincial Governors with effect from 17.05.2023. Mr. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardana, Governor North Western Province, Mrs. P. S. M. Charles Governor of the Northern Province, Mr. Senthil Thondaman, Governor of the Eastern Province
reasoning: This gazette exclusively lists the appointments of named individuals (Mr. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardana, Mrs. P. S. M. Charles, Mr. Senthil Thondaman) to the general title of "Hon. Governor" of their respective provinces. It does not include any details about their portfolio responsibilities, duties, or functions, making it a pure personnel announcement.
